TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR

title: Pony | Unicorn Hair Colour
description: Pony - Semi-Permanent Fantasy Hair Colour Introducing Unicorn Hair, hyper-performance hair colour from Lime Crime that leaves hair feeling silky smooth and smelling like a meadow! Colour: Electric Violet-Purple Weight:  6.76 fl oz / 200 mL 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free HOW TO USE: Apply to pre-bleached, clean, unconditioned hair. Massage colour into each strand. For longer-lasting, more intense results, leave the dye in for 1-2 hours. For more pastel results, wash out after 30 minutes. Don’t worry, Unicorn Hair will not damage your hair, as it does not contain any harsh chemicals or bleach! Rinse until water runs clear, shampoo & condition as usual. To extend the life of your colour, use shampoo for colour-treated hair in between colourings. Caution:  This product is not intended for use anywhere on the face or in the immediate eye area, it must not be used to dye the eyelashes or eyebrows, to do so may cause harm to the eyes. Always protect your clothing and workspace prior to application; wear gloves. Perform a preliminary patch test, as Unicorn Hair contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. You can use a cotton swab to apply a tiny amount of Unicorn Hair to the skin (usually on the nape of the neck or near the elbow). Wait 24 hours and be alert for any signs of redness or irritation. If any irritation presents discontinue use immediately. Unicorn Hair is ready to use. Do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colourant. Unicorn Hair may temporarily stain skin and will permanently stain fabric. Keep out of reach of children. LIME CRIME

title: Vivids Pink | Hair Colour
description: Vivids Pink | HAIR COLOUR One of the fastest growing and innovative colour brands brings us long-lasting, intense hair colour that does not transfer onto other strands or into other colours. Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form. Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml Dimensions : 5 x 3 x 20 cm PRAVANA CHROMASILK

Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form.   Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml Dimensions : 5 x 3 x 20 cm PRAVANA CHROMASILK

title: Juicy | Unicorn Hair Colour
description: Juicy - Semi-Permanent Fantasy Hair Colour Lime Crime's Unicorn Hair is hyper-performance hair colour that leaves hair feeling silky-smooth and smelling like a meadow!  Colour: Fuchsia - Full Coverage Weight:  6.76 fl oz / 200 mL 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free HOW TO USE: Apply to pre-bleached, clean, unconditioned hair. Massage colour into each strand. For longer-lasting, more intense results, leave the dye in for 1-2 hours. For more pastel results, wash out after 30 minutes. Don’t worry, Unicorn Hair will not damage your hair, as it does not contain any harsh chemicals or bleach! Rinse until water runs clear, shampoo & condition as usual. To extend the life of your colour, use shampoo for colour-treated hair in between colourings. Caution:  This product is not intended for use anywhere on the face or in the immediate eye area, it must not be used to dye the eyelashes or eyebrows, to do so may cause harm to the eyes. Always protect your clothing and workspace prior to application; wear gloves. Perform a preliminary patch test, as Unicorn Hair contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. You can use a cotton swab to apply a tiny amount of Unicorn Hair to the skin (usually on the nape of the neck or near the elbow). Wait 24 hours and be alert for any signs of redness or irritation. If any irritation presents discontinue use immediately. Unicorn Hair is ready to use. Do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colourant. Unicorn Hair may temporarily stain skin and will permanently stain fabric. Keep out of reach of children. LIME CRIME

title: Natural Black | Hair Colour
description: Natural Black Hair Colour Crazy Colour Semi-permanent bright & bold hair colour! Crazy Color Natural Black is a brown/black perfect for covering naturally dark hair or creating a shadow root. Can be used over hair that's already dark right up to lightest blondes. 100% Vegan and Cruelty Free! To get the best result from your Crazy Color hair dye we recommend you use it on pre-lightened hair, but it can also be used as a tint on natural hair. This dye is a semi-permanent colour which means it will fade with every wash, but should last approx 4-8 washes depending on hair condition & type. WEIGHT:  100ml INSTRUCTIONS : - Strand & sensitivity tests are always recommended before any sort of dye is applied. - Shampoo your hair with a PH neutral shampoo, don't use conditioner, towel dry your hair. - Apply Crazy Color directly while hair is still damp, spreading evenly over the hair (wear gloves). - Leave for 15/30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly until water runs clear. TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR

title: Toxic Uv | Hair Colour
description: DON'T YOU KNOW THAT YOU'RE TOXIC. Crazy Colour Semi-permanent bright & bold hair colour! It's NEON - Introducing TOXIC UV, This ultra glowing green is not for the faint-hearted. Make em' stop and stare, with a shade that pop's in both natural and blacklight.   For best results apply to pale or platinum blonde hair. 100% Vegan and Cruelty Free! To get the best result from your Crazy Color hair dye we recommend you use it on pre-lightened hair, but it can also be used as a tint on natural hair. This dye is a semi-permanent colour which means it will fade with every wash, but should last approx 4-8 washes depending on hair condition & type. WEIGHT:  100ml INSTRUCTIONS : - Strand & sensitivity tests are always recommended before any sort of dye is applied. - Shampoo your hair with a PH neutral shampoo, don't use conditioner, towel dry your hair. - Apply Crazy Color directly while hair is still damp, spreading evenly over the hair (wear gloves). - Leave for 15/30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly until water runs clear. TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR Shop all Hair Colour Shop all  Crazy Colour

title: Vivids Violet | Hair Colour
description: One of the fastest growing and innovative colour brands brings us long-lasting, intense hair colour that does not transfer onto other strands or into other colours. Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form. Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml Dimensions : 5 x 3 x 20 cm PRAVANA CHROMASILK
